decisions.statement: A locked per-item rule is refused unless the call says `--force`.
Nothing the web alone shows reaches the addon.
An id no per-item rule carries refuses the call.
A call naming no field to change is refused, naming the fields it changes.
A destination that is no destination is refused before the store is read.
The act that changes takes the store it writes through rather than reaching it.
A change is named on the caller's list as soon as that write has gone through.
A rule left unwritten is named nowhere, whether it was refused, locked or unfound.

definition: the command changing the fields of a per-item rule named by its id
